slub_sysfs_leak.trigger: fail-nth 85 of erofs init: kmalloc in create_unique_id(), inlined into sysfs_slab_add(), while creating the erofs_pcluster-1 cache
mechanism: sysfs_slab_add() returns before kobject_init_and_add() when create_unique_id() fails, so the cache's kobject is never initialised
do_kmem_cache_create() treats sysfs failure as non-fatal and keeps the cache
kmem_cache_destroy() unlinks the cache and calls kobject_put() on the uninitialised kobject: WARN, refcount underflow, kmem_cache_release() never runs
the struct kmem_cache, its per-node structures and its name stay allocated and unreferenced
slub_sysfs_leak.upstream: unchanged in mainline 7.3 and linux-next (next-20261020) as of 2026-10-20

null_blk_crash.component: block/genhd.c disk_scan_partitions() deferred fput + module init failure
null_blk_crash.trigger: fail-nth 739 of null_blk init: kmalloc in configfs_register_subsystem(), after null_init() has added its disk
mechanism: add_disk() -> disk_scan_partitions() opens the whole disk (taking a module reference through disk->fops->owner) and drops it with fput(); called from a user task (finit_module), the final __fput() is deferred to task_work
configfs_register_subsystem() then fails; null_init() destroys its device and returns the error, and the module loader frees the module
on return to user space the deferred __fput() runs bdev_release(), whose module_put(disk->fops->owner) reads the freed module's block_device_operations
null_blk_crash.upstream: unchanged in mainline 7.3 (disk_scan_partitions() still uses fput(); null_init() still registers configfs after creating devices)
null_blk_crash.fix: releasing the scan file synchronously (__fput_sync()) is documented as reserved for kernel threads; the fix belongs to the block / module-loader maintainers

ntfs3_do_action_leak.found_by: static analysis (high-confidence warning), confirmed by reading the source
mechanism: for an InitializeFileRecordSegment log record whose MFT record cannot be read (mi_get() fails), do_action() allocates a struct mft_inode with kzalloc()
mi_format_new() can fail (mi_init()'s buffer allocation, or ntfs_get_bh() after mi->mrec was allocated) and does not free mi
do_action() then returns the error without mi_put(): the mft_inode (and mi->mrec) leak; on success the object is released by mi_put() at the out label
ntfs3_do_action_leak.upstream: unchanged in mainline 7.3 and linux-next (next-20261020); a web search found no existing report or fix
ntfs3_do_action_leak.runtime: not confirmed at runtime, which needs an NTFS image with a dirty log that replays InitializeFileRecordSegment for an unreadable record

f2fs_sysfs_leak.trigger: fault points 369-429 of f2fs init: allocations inside kobject_init_and_add() for the "features" and "tuning" kobjects
mechanism: kobject_init_and_add() requires kobject_put() even when it fails (the kobject name is already allocated)
f2fs_init_sysfs() jumps past kobject_put(&f2fs_feat) when adding "features" fails and past kobject_put(&f2fs_tune) when adding "tuning" fails
initialisation fails, the module is freed, and the kstrdup'd kobject names are left unreferenced

introduced_by.subject: f2fs: fix uninitialized kobject put in f2fs_init_sysfs()
introduced_by.note: the rewrite stopped putting an uninitialised f2fs_tune but also stopped putting the kobject whose own kobject_init_and_add() failed; backported to stable (present in 6.18.55)

ufs_bforget_leak.component: fs/ufs/util.c ubh_bforget(), called by fs/ufs/inode.c free_full_branch()
ufs_bforget_leak.found_by: static analysis (warning), confirmed by reading the source
mechanism: free_full_branch() reads an indirect block with ubh_bread(), which kmallocs a struct ufs_buffer_head
it ends with ubh_bforget(ubh), which bforget()s the buffers but, unlike ubh_brelse(), does not kfree() the ufs_buffer_head
one ufs_buffer_head leaks for every indirect block freed when a file is truncated or deleted
ufs_bforget_leak.upstream: unchanged in mainline 7.3; the leak was reported with a fix in 2018 ("ufs: Fix memory leak in the unlink path", Luis Henriques) that is not in mainline
ufs_bforget_leak.runtime: not confirmed at runtime, which needs a mounted UFS image and a truncate
